name: Thrash
description: You thrash about wildly, doing several attacks without control. Make a melee attack roll, doing {dice} {type} damage on a hit. After successfully hitting a target, roll a d4. On a result of 3 or 4, you immediately strike again for 1d10 {type} damage, then roll another d4, and on a result of 3 or 4, you immediately strike one last time for 1d10 {type} damage. At the end of this attack, you become confused.
